name: program-runtime.research-supervision-read
purpose: Collect explicitly selected native goal state and Agent Manager run evidence for a research supervisor without inferring task success.

session_id.description: Authorized Web Console session; required when threads are selected, at most 256 characters.

threads.description: Up to 16 explicit native thread IDs.

run_ids.description: Up to 8 explicit Agent Manager run IDs; no identity mapping is inferred.

event_cursors.description: Optional selected run IDs mapped to an exclusive sequence, or null to start at the beginning. One bounded page per run.

assumptions: Caller owns selection and identity mapping.
The parent must assess source freshness and all returned statuses.
invariants: Read only; no inference, dispatch, retries or mutations.
Each selected source is read once; missing sources remain not_requested or unknown.
Event summaries contain retained-page counts and cursors, not payloads; has_more means the cursor has not caught up and an empty page does not prove coverage or freshness.
No thread/run identity join, task success, wakeup, cleanup or deadline enforcement is inferred.
One bounded JSON envelope is returned.

signals.sources: Per-source statuses, signals and errors; event pages include counts, exclusive next cursor and has_more; not_requested is not complete coverage. An omitted_due_to_output_limit source is unknown and must be inspected separately.
signals.attention: Explicit blocked, budget-limited or failed native goals, failed or cancelled runs, and event backlogs, with source and subject; an empty list does not prove health or complete coverage.
signals.decision: Always review_required; no conclusion about work success.
signals.output_truncated: True when combined output exceeds its declared tier; unaffected sources are retained when possible.

outputs.evidence: Child program names and available artifact identities.
